channel.title: Workspace Roles on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Workspace Roles on KubeSphere

item.title: Create Workspace Role
item.description: This section describes how to create a workspace role. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Role Management permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Role Management permissions and enter your workspace. Click Workspace Settings > Workspace Roles in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Workspace Role List
item.description: This section describes how to view the workspace role list. Each workspace role contains specific workspace management or viewing permissions. You can grant roles containing specific permissions to workspace members to control their permissions within the workspace. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Role Viewing permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Role Viewing permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: View Workspace Role Details
item.description: This section describes how to view workspace role details. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Role View permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Role View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Workspace Settings > Workspace Roles in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Workspace Role Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit workspace role information. You can edit the alias and description of a workspace role created by a user. KubeSphere does not support editing built-in workspace roles, nor does it support editing the name of a workspace role. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Role Management permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles.

item.title: Edit Workspace Role Permissions
item.description: This section describes how to edit workspace role permissions. You can only edit the permissions of user-created workspace roles. The permissions of built-in workspace roles cannot be edited. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Role Management permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Role Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Delete Workspace Role
item.description: This section describes how to delete a workspace role. You can delete user-created workspace roles. Built-in workspace roles cannot be deleted. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Role Management permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles. If the workspace role you want to delete has already been assigned to workspace members, you need to delete the workspace members or modify their roles.
